summary: Managed cloud database service for MongoDB with an administration API for clusters, projects and users.
access_note: Create an Atlas account; an Organization Owner creates service accounts or API keys.
blocker_note: Credentials are created by an Organization Owner; users without that role cannot self-create them.

evidence.quote: Service accounts are the recommended method to manage authentication to the Atlas Administration API.
API keys are a legacy method of authenticating to the Atlas Administration API that uses HTTP Digest Authentication.
You have an Atlas account. To create one, see
Programmatically perform administrative tasks on your Atlas cluster outside of the Atlas UI with the Atlas Administration API.
The MongoDB MCP Server lets you connect to MongoDB from your agentic AI tools, assistants, and platforms.

notes: Fetched docs do not say the API is REST (inferred) or that a free tier can use it. Admin API covers control plane only; data access goes through the MCP server or drivers. Docs mention Local MCP and Atlas Managed MCP; mcp_url is the docs page, not a hosted endpoint. The page gave conflicting role requirements for API key project access.
